records.summary: A versioned source-adoption model, not a whole-mixture physical validation. Unreviewed species retain their pinned FastChem fits. Atomic translation uses unit heavy-particle mass ratios and electron spin two, as in the approved audit. Partition fit terms are numerical basis functions, not measured new levels.

Revised preliminary FastChem / curated HCN mole-fraction differences at the largest absolute log-ratio points on each sampled profile: isothermal: -4.38% at 4000 K and 100 bar; inverted: -4.67% at 3400 K and 39.8107 bar. Two 161-layer profiles from #284/#298; fixed 537-species network and solar budget. Only standard logK.dat solved; other archives audited. No spectra or retrieval. Normalized Asplund 2021 composition; the same ExoGibbs solver for all tables. Extrema include only points with mole fraction >=1e-12 in either table. Differences include coupled atomic abundances. These are recorded model sensitivities, not accuracy rankings, error bounds or a calibrated uncertainty distribution. Your conditions have not been evaluated.

Former curated default, retained as curated_c2h: NASA C2H thermal functions and balanced ATcT 1.172 atomization energy supersede the 1967 JANAF estimate. Energy alignment alone does not remove the old thermal discrepancy. curated_v1 preserves the original. New cold solves pass in both networks (75 conditions each); ion-inclusive results reproduce the archived corrected candidate. The archived 75 paired gas-only conditions span 1500-4000 K, 1e-6-100 bar and C/O=0.5888436553555908, 1, 1.5. At C/O=1.5, 2000 K and 1e-6 bar, HCN increases 47.16% and C2H2 increases by a factor of 2.5585. All species re-equilibrate; this is source sensitivity, not an accuracy ranking. Conditional source adoption leaves thermal and whole-mixture physical uncertainty unquantified. The old HCN study does not validate this changed dataset. Your conditions have not been evaluated.

Former default, retained as curated_tio: curated-tio-v1 replaces only TiO in curated-c2h-v1 with TOTO state thermodynamics and Jain 2023 D0=6.824 +/- 0.010 eV, on 1500-4000 K. The representative 48Ti16O internal partition uses NASA elemental mass and atomic reference functions. C2H and all other functions are retained. The obsolete JANAF low-singlet assumption motivates the thermal update; the D0 difference is within the former quoted uncertainty. Both factory modes pass 75 new cold solves, and ion-inclusive results reproduce the reviewed candidate. Physical atmospheric accuracy and complete thermochemical uncertainty remain unquantified. curated_c2h and curated_v1 preserve earlier datasets. Your conditions have not been evaluated.

Former default, retained as curated_co2: curated-co2-v1 adopts the exact reviewed NIST 626 thermal model on curated-tio-v1 at 1500-4000 K. NASA molecular mass 44.0095 u, NASA atomic functions and ATcT 1.172 total atomization 1598.180 kJ/mol are retained. Only CO2 thermochemistry changes; TiO, C2H, all other species and budgets are preserved. Both factory modes pass 75 new cold solves, and ion-inclusive results reproduce the reviewed candidate. Scoped scientific selection and numerical adoption are supported; complete isotope, continuum, high-temperature cutoff and atmospheric physical accuracy remain unknown. The fixed-isotope-average diagnostic is not adopted as a natural-isotope correction. curated_tio, curated_c2h and curated_v1 preserve earlier datasets. Your conditions have not been evaluated.

records.summary: Former default, retained as curated_h2o: curated-h2o-v1 adopts the exact reviewed evaluated-2025 water Cp polynomial and analytic H/S integrals on curated-co2-v1 at 1500-4000 K. The representative H2(16O) internal model uses NASA aggregate mass 18.01528 u, NASA atoms and retained ATcT 1.172 total atomization 917.819 kJ/mol. CO2, TiO, C2H and all other formation functions are preserved from the base. Joint CO2/H2O production passes 150 new cold solves across both networks; six tighter independently assembled candidate solves and two FastChem comparisons check numerical response. Earlier single-species responses are not relabeled as joint results. Scoped scientific selection and numerical adoption are supported; scattering assignment, complete isotope treatment and physical atmospheric accuracy remain unknown. Earlier versioned presets and their evidence remain available. Your conditions have not been evaluated.

records.summary: Former default, retained as curated_oh: curated-oh-v1 replaces the inherited JANAF OH electronic/caloric defect with the exact NASA9 reaction and balanced ATcT 1.172 D0=425.604 kJ/mol, on curated-h2o-v1 at 1500-4000 K. Only OH changes; H2O, CO2, TiO, C2H, other formation functions, species and budgets are retained. MYTHOS is a finite-state thermal control, differing by less than 0.098 percent in K; it is not adopted. Both network modes pass 75 fresh cold solves, six tighter candidate controls and two independent FastChem comparisons. Scoped source selection and numerical adoption are supported; complete isotope, continuum, energy covariance and atmospheric physical accuracy remain unknown. Only KH changes; OH, H2O, CO2, TiO, C2H, species and budgets remain fixed. Both networks pass 75 fresh cold solves, six tighter candidate controls and two FastChem comparisons. The 1988 abstract's De uncertainty is not a D0 uncertainty. NASA thermal-reference controls change molecular and atomic thermal functions and are not adopted.
